vector<long long> a;

int main() {
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0);
  
  long long m = 0;
  while (a.size() < 17) {
    a.push_back(m);
    m = m * 10 + 1;
  }
  
  long long n;
  cin >> n;
  
  function<long long(long long, long long)> fn = [&](long long n, long long l) -> long long {
    long long num = n / a[l];
    n %= a[l];
    if (!n) return num * l;
    return num * l + min(l + fn(a[l] - n, l - 1), fn(n, l - 1));
  };
  
  cout << fn(n, 16);
  return 0;
